section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the statistical analyses used in the study, including a two-stage factor analytic approach to examine the factor structure of the BAS-2 (Body Appreciation Scale-2) using data from two subsamples analyzed separately for men and women. The study employed principal-axis factor analysis for the first subsample and confirmatory factor analysis (CFA) for the second subsample, with measurement invariance testing via Multigroup CFA (MGCFA). Pearson correlation coefficients were calculated between body appreciation and various variables including BMI, though specific correlation values are not reported in this methods section.
